exact_statement:
theorem affine_lift_lower_bound :
    ∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C → ∃ n₀ : ℕ, 4 ≤ n₀ ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → Even n → ∀ r : ℕ,
        HasAffineLift n r → (n : ℝ) ^ C < (r : ℝ)
